references.text: Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh received their territory east of the Jordan, as decided under Moses' leadership.
Moses gave the land of Gilead to Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as their inheritance.
Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan.
Moses refers to how Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh received the land east of the Jordan.
The land given as an inheritance to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh of their obligation before they could return to their land east of the Jordan.
Description of the territory that Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh received on the east side of the Jordan.
The assembly of Israel at Shiloh, the same place from which the tribes departed.
Joshua sends Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh home after they completed their service.
